SSS11.name: 时光鲽
SSS11.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with a low head, both eyes set close together near the upper edge, a small mouth, a continuous curved lateral line, a short caudal peduncle
SSS11.fins: a long dorsal fin running the full length of the body, a matching long anal fin, a rounded tail fin
SSS11.markings: a faint sunburst of thin lines radiating from the eye

SSS12.name: 琥珀鲷
SSS12.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with a steep forehead, a large blunt head, a small mouth, the upper jaw slightly longer than the lower, ctenoid scales, a complete lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
SSS12.fins: a single long dorsal fin with low spines, a slightly forked tail fin, long pointed pectoral fins
SSS12.markings: faint concentric growth rings around the eye, a single spot at the base of the tail

SSS13.name: 遗迹石斑
SSS13.form: a stout oval body with a large head, a slightly concave forehead, a wide oblique mouth, the lower jaw projecting, small ctenoid scales, a gently curved lateral line, a deep caudal peduncle
SSS13.fins: a long dorsal fin with strong spines and a rounded soft portion, a rounded tail fin, large rounded pectoral fins
SSS13.markings: eroded irregular patches scattered along the upper flank

SSS14.name: 残响鲻
SSS14.form: an elongated cylindrical body with a slightly flattened back, a small conical head, a short blunt snout, a small inferior mouth, cycloid scales, a faint incomplete lateral line, a slender caudal peduncle
SSS14.fins: two separate short dorsal fins, a forked tail fin, pointed pectoral fins set high on the flank
SSS14.markings: a row of faint longitudinal lines along the flank

SSS15.name: 静默鳕
SSS15.form: an elongated slightly compressed body, a large head, a short blunt snout, a terminal mouth, a single chin barbel, small cycloid scales, a curved lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
SSS15.fins: three separate dorsal fins, two separate anal fins, a slightly rounded tail fin, pointed pectoral fins
SSS15.markings: a faint marbled pattern along the upper flank

SSS16.name: 尘时鲹
SSS16.form: a fusiform body with a rounded belly, a pointed conical head, a small terminal mouth, cycloid scales, a slightly curved lateral line, a narrow compressed caudal peduncle
SSS16.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, long sickle-shaped pectoral fins
SSS16.markings: a scattering of fine granular points along the upper flank

SSS17.name: 初雪鳟
SSS17.form: an elongated fusiform body with a slightly arched back, a conical head, a short pointed snout, a terminal mouth, small cycloid scales, a straight lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
SSS17.fins: a short dorsal fin, a small fleshy adipose fin, a slightly forked tail fin, pointed pectoral fins
SSS17.markings: a row of small scattered flakes along the flank, a few flakes on the gill cover

SSS18.name: 沙漏鲽
SSS18.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with a low head, both eyes set close together near the upper edge, a small mouth, a curved lateral line, a short caudal peduncle
SSS18.fins: a long dorsal fin running the full length of the body, a matching long anal fin, a rounded tail fin
SSS18.markings: an hourglass-shaped band across the middle of the flank

SSS19.name: 回音鲈
SSS19.form: a stout oval body with a straight upper profile, a large head, a slightly concave forehead, a wide terminal mouth, the lower jaw projecting slightly, ctenoid scales, a gently arched lateral line
SSS19.fins: a dorsal fin with a deep notch between the spiny and soft parts, a slightly concave tail fin, fan-shaped pectoral fins
SSS19.markings: a series of nested arcs echoing along the flank

SSS20.name: 旧日鲳
SSS20.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with smooth edges, a small blunt head, a short snout, a small terminal mouth, the upper jaw slightly longer than the lower, a slender compressed caudal peduncle
SSS20.fins: a long dorsal fin, a matching long anal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, long slender pectoral fins
SSS20.markings: a faint vertical band marking the midpoint of the flank
